backfillRows.why: feat-1131 prints "If you could already cast spells, these spells are of the same tradition. Otherwise, they are arcane spells". The three grants hard-code tradition 'arcane', and build.ts votes the innate entry's tradition from the grants' own tradition before ever reaching caster?.tradition, so a divine cleric read them as arcane. traditionFromCasting prefers the caster's tradition and keeps the printed 'arcane' as the not-a-caster fallback. Whole value re-emitted from the shipped overlay row (three grants, every field kept).

feat-2237 prints "If you can already cast spells, these spells are of the same tradition. Otherwise, they're arcane spells" — the same clause and the same defect as lore-seeker. Whole value re-emitted from the shipped overlay row.

findings.note: The SAME SENTENCE'S second half on the same two lane siblings. No collision: the other three b032 specs touch neither record.

findings.note: CODE ONLY, no rows — the whole lane is registry-keyed. src/rules/featGrants.ts: FeatGrant.bonusSkillFeat widened boolean -> boolean | number, plus the exported bonusSkillFeatCount / bonusSkillFeatKey helpers. src/rules/featGrantsLane.ts: 'magical-knowledge' gains bonusSkillFeat: 2. src/rules/build.ts: the injection loop and the reconstruction loop both walk the count and key each pick with bonusSkillFeatKey (index 0 = the bare feat id, so no saved character moves). src/builder/Builder.tsx: one picker per granted feat, each hiding the sibling pickers' answers so a printed grant cannot be spent on a duplicate buildCharacter would drop.
